items.a: {TEAM} (MADW) is a women's cycling team from Wrocław, Poland, founded in {founded}. It holds a {UCI_STATUS} licence, runs its own junior (U19) squad and races on the road, on the track and in cyclocross in Poland and abroad.

items.q: Is it a professional team? What UCI level is it?
items.a: The team is registered with the UCI (Union Cycliste Internationale) as a {UCI_STATUS} women's team. That is the third tier of women's road cycling, after UCI Women's WorldTeams and UCI Women's ProTeams. Its riders race UCI-classified events across Europe and national races in Poland.
As of {asOf}, the {rosterSeason} roster has {riders}: {u19} U19, {u23} U23 and {elite} Elite. Elite: {eliteNames}. U23: {u23Names}. U19 juniors: {u19Names}.

items.q: What did the team win in {resultsSeason}?
items.a: In {resultsSeason}, {TEAM} riders won {titles} and {medals} in total (each event, category and place counted once; team events count once). The team raced {races} in {countries}.

items.q: Where can I watch the team race this season?
items.a: Every race the team rides is on the calendar on this site. {calSentence} You can subscribe to the calendar (.ics) in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook. Results and race photos are posted on Instagram at {instagram}.

items.q: What bikes and wheels does the team use?
items.a: The team races on {wheels} carbon wheels. {wheels} is a Polish carbon wheel manufacturer from Podkarpacie and one of the team's main sponsors. The team's technical partners are {technicalPartners}.

items.q: How can a young rider join the junior team?
items.a: The junior squad races in the UCI women's junior category (U19): riders who turn 17 or 18 in the season. To apply, write to {EMAIL} with your name, year of birth, current club, disciplines and best results. Juniors on the {rosterSeason} roster: {u19}.

items.q: How can a company sponsor the team?
items.a: The team arranges partnerships directly. Write to {EMAIL}. The current partners are on the Partners page.

items.q: How can journalists contact the team or get photos?
items.a: The media centre has team facts, the boilerplate, logos, photos and rider portraits, free for editorial use without a login. Press enquiries: {EMAIL}.
